Meta.title: Yashkumar Bagaria | Portfolio
Meta.description: Software engineer across embedded/IoT, systems and web/mobile, based in Nagoya, Japan.

Home.intro: I'm an engineer based in Nagoya, Japan. I started with embedded firmware and IoT, and today I build AWS data pipelines, modernise legacy systems, and ship web and mobile apps.

embedded.title: Embedded
embedded.body: ESP32 firmware, mesh networks, sensors and Modbus-based energy meters.

systems.title: Systems
systems.body: COBOL-to-AWS migration, ETL pipelines, and Java/Python maintenance for JAXA D-NET.

webmobile.title: Web / Mobile
webmobile.body: Flutter apps, Next.js and MedusaJS e-commerce, and WooCommerce.

About.title: About me
About.summary: I started as a freelance developer in 2014 and have worked across embedded firmware, IoT, Flutter mobile apps and full-stack web. I joined Fundasta in November 2024 and have been based in Nagoya since November 2025, working on AWS ETL pipelines, legacy migration and maintenance of JAXA's D-NET system. Embedded systems remain my biggest passion. I'm currently learning React, AWS and Japanese, and I'm aiming to grow into a project manager role.
